# GAMC Global Solutions

> GAMC Global Solutions is an ISO certification services provider based in Dubai, UAE, offering accredited ISO certification (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001, ISO 27001, and other management system standards) through a secure online client portal.

GAMC helps organizations get ISO certified through a subscription-based online process: clients choose an accreditation body and the ISO standard(s) they need, submit required documents, and receive a digital certificate that renews automatically every 1 or 3 years.

## Key facts

- Company: GAMC Global Solutions
- Location: Al Garhoud, Dubai, United Arab Emirates
- Contact: iso@gloria-c.com, +971 56 270 3015 (also WhatsApp)
- Services: ISO certification consulting and issuance for standards including ISO 9001 (Quality Management), ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), ISO 45001 (Occupational Health & Safety), ISO 27001 (Information Security), and other ISO/management-system standards
- Certification model: subscription-based, auto-renewing every 1 or 3 years
- Languages: English and Arabic
